calls.result_text:
SQL:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', events.event_ts) AS "events.event_ts",
  COUNT(*) AS "events._count",
  CAST(SUM(events.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "events.amount_sum",
  COUNT(events.amount) AS "events.amount_count"
FROM events AS events
WHERE
  (
    events.event_ts >= CAST('2025-03-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND events.event_ts < CAST('2025-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
  )
GROUP BY
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', events.event_ts)
LIMIT 21
